kubernetes_add_node_pool_description: You can configure one or more node pools as soon as the cluster is created. A node pool is a group of worker nodes that all have the same configuration.
kube_common_node_pool_volumes_descriptio: Volumes are storage attached to your instance. Every instance needs at least one block volume for its system disk, and you can attach up to 16 block volumes in total.
kube_common_node_pool_volumes_system_not: V0 - one fixed volume. The {{size}} system volume is mandatory and can't be resized or removed. Process storage is now its own line item.
kube_common_node_pool_volumes_size_locke: This size is fixed and cannot be changed
